elements.title: Composite image of a partial solar eclipse over the Washington Monument
elements.content: A composite image shows multiple exposures of a partial solar eclipse progressing diagonally across the sky over the Washington Monument, with silhouetted tree branches at left. Printed caption: “This composite image of multiple exposures shows the progression of a partial solar eclipse over the Washington Monument, Monday, April 8, 2024, in Washington. A total solar eclipse swept across a narrow portion of the North American continent from Mexico’s Pacific coast to the Atlantic coast of Newfoundland, Canada. A partial solar eclipse was visible across the entire North American continent along with parts of Central America and Europe.” Photo credit: NASA/Bill Ingalls

This composite image of multiple exposures shows the progression of a 
partial solar eclipse over the Washington Monument, Monday, April 8, 2024, 
in Washington. A total solar eclipse swept across a narrow portion of the 
North American continent from Mexico’s Pacific coast to the Atlantic coast 
of Newfoundland, Canada. A partial solar eclipse was visible across the entire 
North American continent along with parts of Central America and Europe.
